 Mifepristone monographs information webinar
 Mifepristone monographs information webinar
 27 October 2026 14:00 – 15:00 CET 
 Reading time: 
 This webinar will disseminate the newly published mifepristone monographs by providing information on their development, intended purpose and added value, and engaging with partners on their use.
 The webinar will include : 
 An introduction to The International Pharmacopoeia 
 The added value of Pharmacopoeial standards
 The development process of the monographs
 How monographs are used to promote access to essential medicines
 And will also provide time for a Q&A. 
 Participants will learn how the newly published mifepristone monographs were developed and how they can support consistent product quality assessment across manufacturers, regulators, laboratories and procurement agencies. Participants will also gain practical insights into using pharmacopoeial standards to strengthen access to quality-assured medicines, with an opportunity to ask questions and engage directly with experts.
